links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of LLMs versus Drugs.com against Lexicomp reference for ASM interactions
links.effect: Drugs.com sensitivity 0.870, specificity 0.629, accuracy 0.709; ChatGPT sensitivity 0.842, specificity 0.358; DeepSeek sensitivity 0.877, specificity 0.200. LLMs overpredicted interactions.
links.quote: Drugs.com demonstrated the best overall performance, with sensitivity 0.870, specificity 0.629, and accuracy 0.709.

links.outcome: Specificity of LLMs under single-prompt versus iterative prompting for false positive cases
links.effect: Iterative prompting improved specificity for ChatGPT (0.77) and DeepSeek (0.42), correcting many false positive classifications; single-prompt specificity was 0.358 and 0.200.
links.quote: Iterative prompting substantially improved specificity for ChatGPT (0.77) and DeepSeek (0.42), correcting many false positive classifications.

unlisted_practices: Structured, evidence-constrained iterative prompting to reduce false-positive drug interaction classifications

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT-4, DeepSeek-V3) on drug-drug interaction screening and specifically tests a deployment practice (iterative prompting / structured evidence-constrained prompting on false positives) to improve specificity.
